data.title: New releases for your streaming pleasure: Oct 7-13
data.description: Looking for a title to binge-watch this weekend? Here's our pick!

data.title: Kamin presents 14th Self-Enquiry show 'Mountain Is Mountain, River Is River'
data.description: Kamin Lertchaiprasert presents the 14th exhibition in his Self-Enquiry project, "Mountain Is Mountain, River Is River", which is running at 31st Century Museum of Contemporary Spirit in Chiang Mai until Dec 19.

data.title: It's all in the mind at Munins' 'Still On'
data.description: Thai artist Munins invites everyone to explore how the mind works through three essential processes during "Still On", which is running at RCB Galleria 5, 3rd floor of River City Bangkok, Charoen Krung 24, until Nov 15.

data.title: Melody Of Life is back at CentralWorld
data.description: Music, art, fashion and sustainability will come together at "Chang Music Connection Presents Melody Of Life 17", as the long-running Bangkok music festival returns to CentralWorld from Oct 16-18.

data.title: Comfort vs desire
data.description: Prime Video's A Love Other Than Yours explores the changing emotions of a long-term relationship through four characters searching for love, understanding and connection.

data.title: The Royal Oak is now a necklace
data.description: Audemars Piguet reinterprets the iconic Royal Oak signature band in a high jewellery collection adorned with diamonds and precious stones, bringing together the worlds of horology and haute joaillerie.

data.title: Nene Royal makes voice-acting debut in Disney's 'Hexed'
data.description: Nene Royal, the 16-year-old Thai rocker who won America's Got Talent 2026, will make her acting debut as the Thai voice of Billie Doe, the lead character in Disney's Hexed.

data.title: Thai actors top fashion week global metric charts
data.description: For years, the global fashion-week front row seemed to belong to a familiar club: Hollywood actors, supermodels and K-pop idols whose every appearance could trigger a spike in online conversation. But coming in hot this season is the rise of Thai celebrities in the global spotlight of this Fall's fashion weeks.

data.title: All rise for Blue's return
data.description: The pop quartet — Antony Costa, Duncan James, Lee Ryan and Simon Webbe — will return to Bangkok next January for their 25th Anniversary Asia Tour. Their third concert in Thailand is part of the second leg of their Asia tour.

data.title: Thai Galleries Association stages  new international art fair in Paragon
data.description: The Thai Galleries Association is holding "Art Bangkok 2026 - The First Chapter", a new international art fair to connect Thailand's art scene with the international art world. It will kick off tomorrow and run daily from noon to 7pm until Sunday at NEX Hall and Jewel Zone, 5th floor of Siam Paragon, Rama I Road.

data.title: Gaysorn Amarin showcases prize  watches ahead of Geneva show
data.description: Bangkok has been selected as one of only four global destinations to host the Grand Prix d'Horlogerie de Genève (GPHG) Nomination Tour 2026, at The Forum of Gaysorn Amarin, Phloenchit Road, from Oct 15-18.

data.title: Passion in motion
data.description: Two years after its debut, Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo (HKPAX) 2026 returns with the theme "Passion In Motion".

data.title: Best-selling British author Jeffrey Archer dies aged 86
data.description: LONDON - British author Jeffrey Archer, who penned a series of best-selling novels, served as a Conservative MP and was convicted of perjury, died suddenly at 86, his publisher HarperCollins said.

data.title: Molly turns 20
data.description: Pop Mart Thailand, together with Chulalongkorn University Property Management and the Tourism Authority of Thailand, launched the “Molly 20th Anniversary Exhibition – Bangkok” under the theme “The Little Galaxy – A Journey Through The Universe Of Time”. The Molly mania is taking place at Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park until Oct 25.

data.title: Thai Textile Society hosts shibori summit
data.description: Thai Textile Society is holding the next Collector's Corner talk on "Unfolding Shibori: Techniques, Traditions, And Mastery", at Siam Society, Asok Road, on Saturday at 10am.

data.title: 'ALaLa Dance Fest 2026' is coming to Chiang Mai
data.description: 'Spirit & Ritual" is the theme for "ALaLa Dance Fest 2026", which brings contemporary artists to perform and conduct workshops, at Kalm Village in Chiang Mai from Saturday to Oct 13.

data.title: Unfiltered cinema
data.description: Thamuya Thasananukulkij's first feature film echoes their childhood. They did not want to do what is told, but did not dare to speak up. They could neither fathom nor describe muddy feelings under the surface until they saw a herd of cattle at a friend's house in Suphan Buri, which seemed to understand everything, but could not speak human language. They were interested in how caretakers tame children and animals.

data.title: Remembering the Mighty Sparrow
data.description: The legendary calypso singer and songwriter Mighty Sparrow (Slinger Francisco), known as the "Calypso King of the World", died recently at the age of 91 at his New York home.

data.title: A spooktacular success
data.description: Delusion, the new Thai Netflix thriller, explores the dysfunction families experience while caring for elderly relatives suffering from dementia.

data.title: New movies out this week: Oct 1-7
data.description: Six new releases that hit cinemas in Thailand this week.

data.title: See the world as Hiroka Limviphuvadh  at 'Behind My Eyes' in River City Bangkok
data.description: Thai-Japanese artist and designer Hiroka Limviphuvadh will guide art lovers into the world inspired by the images she sees in her mind, during "Behind My Eyes", which will kick off tomorrow and run daily from 10am to 8pm until Oct 31, at RCB Photographers' Gallery, 2nd floor of River City Bangkok, Charoen Krung 24.

data.title: ‘The Cycle’ is a marriage of ‘Silent Hill’ and ‘Evil Dead’
data.description: If The Cycle is on your watchlist, it might be that you saw Stephen King’s tweet, recommending horror heads to put this “special” on the calendar. Otherwise, this independent werewolf horror film has been flying under the radar, with a very limited release, a worn-out werewolf story and, not least, a poster that looks extremely generic.

data.title: Move along tabis, Margiela has six toes now
data.description: Havaianas’ latest fashion collaboration has added something no flip-flop really needs: a sixth toe.

data.title: Julie Kegels drops the crotch low this spring
data.description: For her first show after being named the 2026 LVMH Prize’s winner, the 28 years old Belgian designer Julie Kegels brings together a collection that seemingly drops the proportions of the female body.

data.title: Nene Royal’s to-do list: write, tour and ‘go back to school’
data.description: Rising Thai teen rock star Nene Royal, fresh off her win on “America’s Got Talent”, says she’s planning to write her own songs, tour — and “go back to school”.

data.title: Julie Kegels drops the crotch low this fall
data.description: For her first show after being named the 2026 LVMH Prize’s winner, the 28 years old Belgian designer Julie Kegels brings together a collection that seemingly drops the proportions of the female body.

data.title: New releases for your streaming pleasure: Sept 30-Oct 6
data.description: Looking for a title to binge-watch this weekend? Here's our pick!

data.title: Molly gets 20th birthday show from Pop Mart Thailand at CU
data.description: Chulalongkorn University Centenary Park is the venue for world-class international art toy show "Molly 20th Anniversary Exhibition - Bangkok", which is running daily from 10am to 9pm, until Oct 25.

data.title: Sharpening creativity
data.description: Satit Kalawantavanich is a legendary graphic designer and the founder of Sam Noh, a graphic design studio, and Phenomena, a renowned advertising and film production house. He is also the creator of Propaganda, an iconic design brand famous for its playful signature character Mr.P. In his 60s, Satit established Studio Avocado which provides creative and strategic consultancy.

data.title: Tom Cruise trades stunts for satire as toxic tycoon ‘Digger’
data.description: PARIS - Tom Cruise is taking on one of his riskiest roles in decades, tackling the politics of climate change and corporate greed in new film “Digger”, in which he plays an embattled, ageing tycoon.

data.title: ‘Exceptional’ Turner painting shown in Rome
data.description: ROME - A particularly well-preserved painting of Rome by the British artist JMW Turner went on display in the city on Tuesday for the first time ahead of an auction in December.
